import tiktoken
from collections import Counter

enc = tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base")

# --- Task 1: chunk_size ---
text = "hello world hello world hello world"
cs = 11
manual = [enc.encode(text[i:i+cs]) for i in range(0, len(text), cs)]
res = enc.encode(text, chunk_size=cs)
assert res == manual, (res, manual)
print("chunking basic OK:", res)

# chunk_size larger than text -> single chunk
assert enc.encode("hi", chunk_size=100) == [enc.encode("hi")]
# empty text -> []
assert enc.encode("", chunk_size=5) == []
# invalid chunk_size
for bad in (0, -3):
    try:
        enc.encode("abc", chunk_size=bad)
        raise AssertionError("should have raised")
    except ValueError as e:
        print("ValueError OK:", e)

# decode roundtrip of chunks
assert "".join(enc.decode(t) for t in res) == text
print("roundtrip OK")

# --- Task 2: return_repeated_pattern ---
t = "the cat sat on the mat and the cat ate the rat"
tokens, patterns = enc.encode(t, return_repeated_pattern=True)
assert tokens == enc.encode(t)
full = Counter(zip(tokens, tokens[1:]))
expected = dict(full.most_common(3))
assert patterns == expected, (patterns, expected)
assert len(patterns) <= 3
print("patterns OK:", patterns)
# every value is a positive int count, keys are 2-tuples of ints
assert all(isinstance(k, tuple) and len(k) == 2 and isinstance(v, int) and v > 0
           for k, v in patterns.items())

# single token -> empty dict
tok1, pat1 = enc.encode("hi", return_repeated_pattern=True)
assert tok1 == enc.encode("hi") and pat1 == {}
# empty -> empty tokens, empty dict
tok0, pat0 = enc.encode("", return_repeated_pattern=True)
assert tok0 == [] and pat0 == {}
print("pattern edge cases OK")

# --- combined ---
res2 = enc.encode(text, chunk_size=cs, return_repeated_pattern=True)
assert isinstance(res2, tuple) and len(res2) == 2
tok_lists, pat_lists = res2
assert tok_lists == manual
assert len(pat_lists) == len(manual)
for toks, pats in zip(tok_lists, pat_lists):
    exp = dict(Counter(zip(toks, toks[1:])).most_common(3))
    assert pats == exp
print("combined OK:", tok_lists, pat_lists)

# --- feature interplay with special tokens ---
enc2 = tiktoken.get_encoding("gpt2")
assert enc2.encode("hi </s>", allowed_special="all", chunk_size=3) == [
    enc2.encode("hi </s>"[i:i+3], allowed_special="all") for i in range(0, 7, 3)
]
# disallowed special token still raises with chunking
try:
    enc2.encode("hello </s> world", chunk_size=5)
    raise AssertionError("should have raised")
except ValueError as e:
    print("disallowed special with chunking OK")
# allowed_special works per chunk
toks, pats = enc2.encode("a </s> b </s> c", allowed_special="all",
                         chunk_size=4, return_repeated_pattern=True)
eot = enc2.eot_token
assert eot in [t for chunk in toks for t in chunk]
assert all(isinstance(p, dict) for p in pats)
print("special tokens + combined OK")

# --- defaults unchanged ---
assert enc.encode("hello world") == [15339, 1917]
assert isinstance(enc.encode("hello world"), list)
print("default behavior OK")

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
